text_block_list.text: Just as I was about to turn around at the call—
Something shot past my side with incredible speed.

"Peeking nervously, I see Sirius Symboli's leg propped against the next wall.
This is what they call—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh? That thing you're swinging around is way more dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Abusing your authority as a Trainer to race over and over.
Do you seriously think you'll get results like this?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Let's sit down and have a nice, long chat. Right, pup—?

Frustration is building up from running in consecutive races.
It looks like we'll need to reconsider the upcoming schedule.
